name: replace-file
title: Replace File
description: Name-clash resolver for uploads: both copies side by side with thumbnail, size and date, a warning plus one-tap Keep both when an older file would replace a newer one, identical copies spotted, renamed-copy preview, and apply-to-all with counts.

meta.summary: Helps prevent an upload from overwriting a newer file with an older one by comparing both copies before replacing.
meta.server: Check the stored file's version or ETag at write time so a stale client choice cannot overwrite a newer upload.
catches: Older incoming file about to replace a newer existing one
Identical copies, with a one-tap Skip
Newer and larger copy highlighted per clash
Name the kept copy will get ("report (1).pdf")
limits: Compares the dates and sizes you pass; file timestamps can be wrong after copies or downloads
"Identical" is inferred from size and date, not a content hash
Does not upload; onContinue receives the choices
a11y: Form labelled by its title; each clash is a radiogroup of native radios named after the file
Warnings and fixes render in polite live regions
Continue is disabled until every clash is decided, with aria-busy while pending
Newer/larger shown in bold text, not colour alone; animation skipped under reduced motion
